summary: Switch's ON track reads two component custom properties (CONVENTIONS §6), declared on the root with today's accent roles as defaults: --ui-switch-track-on-bg (var(--ui-bg-accent-legible)) and --ui-switch-track-on-hover-bg (var(--ui-bg-accent-hover)). Set them on the Switch itself — className="[--ui-switch-track-on-bg:var(--ui-…)]" or style — to give one switch its own colour (a violet agent toggle) instead of an unlayered override; an ancestor cannot set them, because the root's declaration wins. Off and disabled are unaffected. Default rendering is pixel-identical.
